rationale: All E2B arms (A=domain-aware InfoNCE; B=doc-id contrastive; C=plain CE; D=mean-centered) expected to collapse under SFT-only objective. E4B ARM A confirmed total mode collapse (n_unique=1/68, tfidf=0.0) despite kill gate PASS. Root cause: SFT loss can be minimized by finding a format-satisfying template independent of the injected activation. Reconstruction-reward (GRPO/RFT) is the decisive missing piece (F89). E2B is 4x cheaper for prototyping -- a positive E2B GRPO result enables a clean E4B scale test; a negative result stops the burn before GPU block 2.
